Notentisch - Standalone Package

Installation:
1. Extract all files to a folder
2. Double-click Start-Notentisch.bat
3. Browser opens automatically at http://127.0.0.1:8000

Shutdown:
Close the command window or press Ctrl+C

System Requirements:
- Windows 7 or later
- No Python or other software needed!

This folder is portable - copy to any Windows computer.

Access/XML Sync (recommended workflow):
1. Access exports to Noten/Notentisch.xml
2. Board edits and saves Noten/Notentisch.xml
3. Access imports/syncs from Noten/Notentisch.xml

Files with suffixes like Notentisch-Vivobook.xml or Notentisch-PetersBoard.xml
are treated as conflict/test states and are not synced to Access automatically.
These suffix files can appear due to OneDrive conflict copies during parallel edits
on multiple devices, or from separate test runs with different file names.
